item.title: Ebola vaccine trial begins in DR Congo
item.description: An Ebola vaccine trial is underway in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), involving frontline health workers and others involved in the response.

item.title: UN panel calls for stronger safeguards as AI agents advance
item.description: The world's first scientific body on Artificial Intelligence called on Monday for AI safeguards to be adapted as current firewalls are “unravelling”.

item.title: ‘Nowhere is safe’: UN experts detail Ukraine war’s toll and Russia’s reach beyond its borders
item.description: UN Human Rights Council-appointed experts on Monday laid out a grim picture of the human cost of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, with a spotlight on civilians facing a third wartime winter as well as the intimidation of Russians who have fled abroad.

item.title: ‘We are not powerless’: UN chief urges world leaders to invest in peace
item.description: In a world facing rising conflicts, violence and divisions that are causing great suffering for millions of people, the UN chief on Monday called on world leaders and citizens to invest more in peace.

item.title: Why climate action now comes down to speed, finance and cooperation
item.description: Temporarily exceeding the 1.5°C global warming goal set in Paris is widely considered inevitable. The challenge now is to keep that overshoot as small and short as possible by cutting emissions faster, unlocking finance and strengthening international cooperation.

item.title: UN condemns attempted Houthi strike on Riyadh as Yemen displacement surges past 130,000
item.description: The UN has condemned continued cross‑border attacks by Houthi forces against Saudi Arabia, including an attempted strike on the capital Riyadh, as fighting inside Yemen drives one of the country’s fastest displacement surges in years.
